create_discrete_action_space: create a DiscreteActionSpace from a list of PyTorch tensor Action objects with an optional seed
build_from_gym_space: build a DiscreteActionSpace from a Gymnasium Discrete space using the from_gym static method
get_actions_batch_tensor: get a stacked tensor of shape (b, d) from all actions in the DiscreteActionSpace via actions_batch
move_actions_to_device: move all action tensors in a DiscreteActionSpace to a specified PyTorch device using to()
validate_action_shapes: validate that all actions in a DiscreteActionSpace share the same 1D tensor shape via _set_validated_elements
